title: Scalar-compatible colimits of canonical localized approximation diagrams
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with a map R→S, M an S-module, and Λ a nonempty directed preorder. Let A,B:Λ→CommRing and D:Λ→AddCommGrp, with D_i a B_i-module, and η:A→B, π:A→const R, κ:B→const S, ν:D→const M. Assume these are colimit cocones, η_i followed by κ_i equals π_i followed by R→S, D transitions are semilinear over the B transitions, and ν_i(bx)=κ_i(b)ν_i(x). No finiteness or tensor base-change assumption is imposed. For q∈Spec S put q_i=κ_i⁻¹q and p_i=η_i⁻¹q_i. Define Aq_i=(A_i)_{p_i}, Bq_i=(B_i)_{q_i}, and Nq_i=(D_i)_{q_i}, with the explicitly constructed fraction transition maps. Then there exist a uniquely determined ring map ψ:colim Aq→colim Bq and uniquely determined colim Bq-module action on colim Nq such that ψ respects the localized stage maps and the colimit coprojections respect stage scalar multiplication. With that action restricted through ψ, colim Nq is flat over colim Aq if and only if M_q is flat over R_p, where p is the contraction of q in R and the R_p action comes from the canonical local map R_p→S_q. All colimits, localization and flatness use [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; primes are points of [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

proof.text: Contract q through κ_i and η_i. Cocone compatibility identifies the resulting A_i prime with the contraction of p=q∩R through π_i. Naturality makes the explicit fraction maps functorial. The localized stage map is Localization.localRingHom; its square commutes on numerators, hence on all fractions.

Apply localization-commutes-with-colimits to A and B, after transporting the supplied IsColimit cocones to canonical colimits. The canonical localized ring colimits are consequently isomorphic to R_p and S_q. Their isomorphisms are uniquely specified by their action on the original stage numerators.

A fraction of M_q has a numerator represented in D_i and denominator represented in B_j. Directedness places both at a common stage, where the denominator avoids the contracted prime. An equality of fractions has a multiplier outside q killing the cross difference. Represent that multiplier at another stage and descend its zero cross difference using the original additive-group colimit. Semilinearity preserves the cross difference under all transitions. Joint surjectivity and eventual equality identify the explicitly defined localized group diagram colimit with M_q.

Transport the S_q-module action to the canonical group colimit through the comparison isomorphisms. On fractions, stage scalar multiplication gives exactly hlimitScalar. The localized stage maps induce ψ and hψ. Colimit joint surjectivity and passage to common stages uniquely determine both ψ and this action; no arbitrary data are selected.

The fraction identities show that the two ring comparisons and the additive comparison intertwine ψ with R_p→S_q and the induced module actions. Transport of tensor maps along these isomorphisms preserves and reflects their injectivity; equivalently flatness is unchanged. This proves the displayed equivalence, with no flatness assumption.

theorem localized_approximation_colimits
    (R S : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module S M]
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)]
    (A B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (η : A ⟶ B)
    (π : A ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of R))
    (κ : B ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of S))
    (D : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (ν : D ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M))
    [∀ i : Λ, Module (B.obj i) (D.obj i)]
    (hA : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of R) π)))
    (hB : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of S) κ)))
    (hD : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (AddCommGrpCat.of M) ν)))
    (hη : ∀ i, η.app i ≫ κ.app i = π.app i ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))
    (hs : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (b : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
      (D.map f).hom (b • x) = (B.map f).hom b • (D.map f).hom x)
    (hν : ∀ i (b : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
      (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) (b • x) =
        (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i)) b •
          (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) x)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) :
    let Aq := primeRingDiagram A (η ≫ κ) q
    let Bq := primeRingDiagram B κ q
    let Nq := primeModuleDiagram B κ q D hs
    ∃ (ψ : (colimit Aq : CommRingCat.{u}) →+* (colimit Bq : CommRingCat.{u}))
      (act : Module (colimit Bq : CommRingCat.{u})
        (colimit Nq : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v})),
      letI := act
      (∀ i, ψ.comp (colimit.ι Aq i).hom =
        (colimit.ι Bq i).hom.comp (primeDiagramHom A B η κ q i)) ∧
      (∀ (i : Λ) (b : Bq.obj i) (x : Nq.obj i),
        (colimit.ι Nq i).hom (b • x) =
          (colimit.ι Bq i).hom b • (colimit.ι Nq i).hom x) ∧
      ((letI := Module.compHom (colimit Nq : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}) ψ
        Module.Flat (colimit Aq : CommRingCat.{u}) (colimit Nq : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v})) ↔
        @Module.Flat (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)))
          (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M) _ _
          (Module.compHom _ (Localization.localRingHom
            (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)) q.asIdeal (algebraMap R S) rfl)))
